text:
alex: hi all, just joined and hit a snag. MBP M2 (Ventura) enrolled in Kandji but FileVault never turned on. I did a quick Ubuntu install earlier this week.

it-support: welcome! can you run `fdesetup status` and `profiles status -type configuration`? often dual-boot changes confuse the recovery path.

alex: `fdesetup status` -> FileVault is Off. Kandji shows DiskEncryption profile Installed and key escrowed. No consent banner in System Settings.

sam: FYI if the recoveryOS path is messed up macOS can block enabling FV. Did the Ubuntu installer touch the EFI or create extra ESP entries?

alex: I did let the installer write to the main disk. Not sure about ESP entries.

it-support: please avoid further boot changes. We can either: 1) schedule a 30m remote session to inspect and trigger enable via MDM, or 2) grant a one-off temp-admin for you to accept the enable prompt if it appears. Which do you prefer?

alex: remote session works. I'll open a Lighthouse ticket and tag it-support.

kandji-bot: Disk encryption profile `com.redwood.disk-encrypt` is installed; escrow key present.

it-support: thanks. when you file the ticket include model, OS build, and mention dual-boot. we'll triage and pick a time. avoid installing updates that touch the bootloader until we fix this.

alex: ticket created: https://lighthouse.redwood.com/tickets/32001 - thanks everyone! :pray:
